name: std::priority_queue<T,Container,Compare>::pop
intro: Removes the top element from the priority queue. Effectively calls std::pop_heap(c.begin(), c.end(), comp); c.pop_back();.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Logarithmic number of comparisons plus the complexity of Container::pop_back.
